name: The Scythe of Elune
shortDescription: The gnarled branch-like weapon in Velinde’s journal; at the end of the original chain it is no longer in her keeping.
body: Interpretive object art based on the journal’s branch-and-weapon description. No exact Classic item model, blade fitting, rune or later redesign is asserted. Kept distinct from a staff such as Atiesh. See docs/research/scythe-of-elune-original-mystery-research.md and docs/research/scythe-of-elune-visual-assets.json.
